formula_or_test: SPFM = (λ_ISIF + λ_SF) / λ_local (per ISO 26262-5:2018, Annex C (normative))
inputs: λ_ISIF: failure rate of independent safe faults
λ_SF: failure rate of safe faults
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level

inputs: λ_MPF_latent: failure rate of latent multi-point faults
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level

calculation: Probabilistic Metric for random Hardware Failures (PMHF)
formula_or_test: PMHF = λ_SPF + λ_RF + (λ_DPF_det × λ_DPF_latent × T_Lifetime) (simplified estimate per ISO 26262-5:2018, Annex F)
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level

formula_or_test: ASIL D: SPFM ≥ 99%, LFM ≥ 90%, PMHF < 10 FIT (≤ 10^-8 per hour)
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level
clause_locator: Clause 8 (Evaluation of the hardware architectural metrics), Clause 9 (Evaluation of the probabilistic metric for random hardware failures)

calculation: US Export Control Total Processing Performance (TPP)
formula_or_test: TPP = Σ (2 × MacTOPS_i × bit_length_i) over all processing units on the IC; ECCN 3A090 applies if TPP ≥ 4800, or TPP ≥ 1600 and Performance Density ≥ 5.92
inputs: MacTOPS_i: theoretical peak Tera operations/sec per unit for multiply-accumulate (D = A × B + C)
bit_length_i: largest bit-length of inputs to the multiply operation
authority: 15 CFR Part 774, Supplement No. 1, Commerce Control List, ECCN 3A090
volatility: High; updated with export control rule changes (e.g., 2022, 2023, 2025)

formula_or_test: FIT = (χ² × 10^9) / (2 × N × H × Af)  (per JEDEC JESD85A)
inputs: χ²: Chi-squared distribution value (based on confidence level and failures)
authority: JEDEC JESD85A: Methods for Calculating Failure Rates in Units of FITs
JEDEC (Arrhenius equation for reliability, referenced in JESD91A, JEP122E, JEP143B.01, JESD74A)

calculation: CHIPS Act Advanced Manufacturing Investment Credit (AMIC)
formula_or_test: Credit = 25% × Qualified Investment (basis of qualified property placed in service in an advanced manufacturing facility) (IRC § 48D)
inputs: Qualified Investment: basis of qualified property
authority: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) § 48D, as enacted by the CHIPS Act of 2022
volatility: Low to Medium; subject to legislative amendments (e.g., proposed increase to 35%)
